codebase-memory.description: WakePoint code-intelligence graph (DeusData codebase-memory-mcp). Additive query layer over the deterministic .wake/ map — 14 tools: search_code, query_graph, trace_path, get_code_snippet, get_architecture, detect_changes, etc. Bootstraps from .codebase-memory/graph.db.zst. scip-dart (.wake/graph) remains the Dart semantic source of truth.
